scope_note_zh: 本包的许可声明与逐资产权利清单。2026-08-19 从 manifest.json 顶层迁出：已发布的 manifest.schema.json 是 additionalProperties=false 且不含扩展槽，license 与 rights_inventory 在其中没有合法位置，会触发 legacy advisory 警告。内容逐字未改，仅更换承载文件，以便在迁移 manifest schema 0.2.x 前先消除该警告。
scope_note_en: This package's licence statement and per-asset rights inventory. Moved out of manifest.json on 2026-08-19: the published manifest.schema.json sets additionalProperties=false with no extension slot, so license and rights_inventory had no legal home there and raised a legacy advisory. Contents are verbatim unchanged; only the carrying file changed.
supersedes_zh: manifest.json#license 与 manifest.json#rights_inventory（2026-08-19 之前的历史条目仍指向旧位置）

license.identifier_source: schema/proposal.schema.json 的 license 枚举值之一；组织方未发布其条款文本
license.author_grant_zh: 作为本包内容的权利人，作者另行授予：对本包内容的任何使用，只要符合 CC BY-NC 4.0（署名、非商业、标明修改），即已获得作者许可。
license.author_grant_en: As rights holders in the contents of this package, the authors additionally grant that any use complying with CC BY-NC 4.0 (attribution, non-commercial, changes indicated) is licensed.
license.required_attribution_line_zh: 本方案为开放共创建议，不代表任何政府决定或审批结论。
license.required_attribution_line_en: This proposal is open co-creation advice and represents no government decision or approval.
license.third_party_exclusion_zh: 本授权不覆盖第三方素材。包内未使用任何第三方图片、地图、商标或受保护版式；字体权利链见 proposal.md 风险与合规一节的字体表与 sources.json 的 FONT-* 条目。
license.government_endorsement_zh: 任何使用不得暗示政府背书、实施批准、已建成或已完成公众参与。
license.precedence_zh: 三个许可信号冲突时的优先顺序，自高到低：(1) 第三方排除范围与政府不背书声明——禁止项，任何授权都不能突破；(2) 权利人的完整授权文本 author_grant_zh/en——权利人对自有权利的直接授予，不需外部文本支持即可执行；(3) 机器可读标识 identifier——条款未发布；若日后被定义得比 (2) 更严则以更严者为准，若被定义得更宽，本包仍只按 (2) 的范围授权。
license.precedence_en: Order of precedence when the three licence signals conflict, highest first: (1) the third-party exclusion and the no-government-endorsement statement, which are prohibitions no grant can override; (2) the rights holders' full grant text in author_grant_zh/en, a direct grant over rights they hold that is enforceable without external support; (3) the machine-readable identifier, whose terms are unpublished — if it is later defined more strictly than (2) the stricter governs, and if more loosely, this package still grants only within the scope of (2).

rights_inventory.notice_zh: 逐资产权利清单。全部资产的权利人均为本包参与者；许可文本以 license.author_grant_zh/en 为准，冲突时按 license.precedence_zh 判定。第三方成分一栏全为「无」，本包据此作出直接授权。
rights_inventory.notice_en: Per-asset rights inventory. The rights holder for every asset is the package participants; the licence text is license.author_grant_zh/en, and conflicts are decided by license.precedence_en. Every third-party cell reads none, which is what allows the direct grant.
